title: bug: a notification-only session can't reply when its idle seat's worker record was pruned (chat_send "Unknown sender"), and the mention stays unread
description:
Observed 2026-10-25T13:09Z: the wrapper launched a notification-only session for worker-07cd2c56 to answer routed mention msg-185b0639451c4fce9e18c139d4298fb2 (chan-b6d8273b). The daemon had no record for that worker (it was absent from list_workers), so the required reply failed. chat_send and chat_join both answer 'Unknown sender: workerId must be a registered worker or "human"' (packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/chatSend.ts:51, chatJoin.ts:31).
Nothing re-registers an idle seat whose record was pruned. retry_team_join returns early once TEAM_JOINED=true (scripts/moe-agent.sh:2064; its ps1 twin is Invoke-MoeTeamJoinRetry). claim_next_task creates the worker only on a successful claim (tools/claimNextTask.ts:648-651), and the notification-only prompt forbids claiming.
Side effect: chat_read silently skips the cursor write for an unknown worker (state/workerStore.ts:214), so the mention is never marked read. It will likely resurface in another notification-only launch on each later no-task iteration (inferred from the code; repeats not yet observed).
definitionOfDone: A notification-only session launched for a seat whose worker record was pruned can send its chat_send reply under that seat's own workerId, never as "human".
Reading the surfaced mention advances that seat's chat cursor, so the same mention does not trigger another notification-only launch.
A regression test (a postflight.{sh,ps1} scenario and/or a daemon test) covers a pruned idle seat with an unread routed mention.

Stub RPC in a test-owned environment to simulate previously joined but now pruned/DEAD seat and unread mention. Assert a healthy cached normal retry remains a no-op, forced retry calls join once, failures keep joined=false and perform no inbox read/CLI launch, and success after refusal restores readiness. Update both wrappers: add explicit force-refresh mode to retry_team_join/Invoke-MoeTeamJoinRetry while preserving default cached retry behavior. Invoke force refresh once at each fresh preflight BEFORE any chat_join/chat_read or routed-mention consumption, including notification-only and idle iterations; never require a successful task claim. Allow governors on this force path and preserve role:'governor' when creating their team. Validate accepted RPC response rather than treating arbitrary nonempty data as success; on force failure clear stale joined state, keep pending mentions unread, suppress notification launch and reuse existing poll/loop handling (a no-loop invocation exits with a clear failure rather than spinning). Error handling must preserve task/baseline state and never fall back to sender human; retry next iteration and deduplicate unchanged failure/success logs. One final verification gate from candidate root: bash -n scripts/moe-agent.sh && node --test scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs && bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && (cd packages/moe-daemon && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test). On Windows run the same command from Git Bash so executable PS5.1/7 tests and parser check run; do not call a skipped native branch verified. No intermediate full-suite gates.

Final adversarial self-review using adversarial-self-review: pruning after a prior successful loop, DEAD after hot reload, busy live seat rejoin, repeated registration, full/missing team, transport exception/MCP isError, governor path and no-loop failure. Ensure identity is restored before cursor consumption, both shell call sites actually execute, unknown chat senders still fail, no stale call revives DEAD, no duplicate membership/log floods, no task claims by notification sessions and no lost baseline/attempt state. Recheck that second read does not repeat original mention. If fixes change bytes, rerun the identical final gate; then complete_task with fresh evidence.

comments.author: governor-96f92f36
comments.content:
Governor finding, 2026-10-26: the same root cause also hits a seat whose record goes DEAD, not just one whose record was pruned. Please plan for both.

Observed: at 04:45:16Z a wrapper hot reload (any edit to scripts/moe-agent.sh) ran the reload path, which calls deregister_worker {reason:"wrapper_restart"} and then exec. Idle worker-3729a0d6 came back as the same process (pid 130561, MOE_WORKER_ID intact) and has been looping "Agent idle, checking for tasks in 30 seconds" ever since. It calls moe RPCs every cycle, yet list_workers has shown it DEAD with lastActivityAt frozen at 04:44:45Z for 15+ minutes. worker-7d158765 was in the same limbo from 03:07Z (pruned) until its own reload re-joined the team at 04:45:41Z.

Why (daemon source):
- joinTeam.ts only creates a record when getWorker() is empty; an existing DEAD record stays DEAD.
- claimNextTask.ts only creates or updates the record (status READING_CONTEXT) on a successful claim. hasNext:false leaves it untouched.
- touchWorker deliberately refuses DEAD records, so heartbeats and other calls never revive it.
So the wrapper comment "the re-exec'd wrapper registers afresh" holds only for a seat that claims a task right away.

Impact: the seat still picks up work, because a claim revives it. But it shows DEAD/hidden in list_workers and the IDE, and mentionRouter skips DEAD workers. Once the record is pruned, chat_send fails with "Unknown sender", which is this task's symptom.

A fix covering both: have a fresh-session registration (join_team at wrapper pre-flight) revive a DEAD record to IDLE. Keep touchWorker's refusal for in-flight calls from the old session. Alternatively, skip the deregister on a reload when the seat holds no task.

comments.author: architect-1520cc31
comments.content: Plan includes the governor's DEAD-record finding, not just pruned records. Minimal fix stays at registration boundary: fresh preflight force-rejoins before chat_join/chat_read (current retry sits after general chat read and returns early when cached joined), and successful join_team revives DEAD to IDLE without relaxing chat sender checks or touchWorker's DEAD refusal. Covers all default role teams, including governors; no task claim is needed. Five files total with dedicated daemon and executable wrapper-block regression tests. To serialize shared files, the already-planned live-assignee wrapper guard and the new daemon worker-type prerequisite now depend on this task; this task has no new dependencies and can run first.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Repair explicit registration, not chat authentication. Auto-registering arbitrary chat senders or weakening touchWorker's DEAD refusal would revive old sessions/impersonation paths. No new MCP tool needed: join_team already creates missing workers. Refresh the wrapper's cached membership at fresh preflight before reading inbox, and revive DEAD only through a successful explicit team join. This is five files, no split required. Claiming tasks solely to recreate identity is forbidden and unnecessary.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Verified ordering bug: sh general chat read at ~6321 precedes cached retry_team_join at ~6346; PS twin same. retry_team_join/Invoke-MoeTeamJoinRetry return immediately when TEAM_JOINED/teamJoined is true and exclude governors. Add force-refresh mode called before first chat_join/read on every preflight; keep normal cached retries cheap. Startup teams default Workers/Architects/QA/Governors; governor team create must retain role:'governor'. joinTeamTool only creates absent records and addTeamMember returns early for existing members, so DEAD needs explicit status IDLE update after successful membership. chatReadTool already writes cursor through updateWorkerCursors when record exists; chatSendTool rejects genuinely unknown worker and reserved system. Tests can use ToolTestHarness, StateManager.deleteWorker, joinTeamTool/chatReadTool/chatSendTool and real extracted launcher blocks.
planningNotes.risks: Governor comment requires both pruned and DEAD seats; include both. Never reset a healthy busy seat's status/currentTaskId or clear cursors during rejoin. Team full/not-found/malformed RPC cannot be counted as success, and failed registration must not consume mentions or launch a doomed notification CLI. Preserve existing cached behavior for ordinary retry sites and log only changes, not one successful-rejoin banner every idle poll. Wrapper changes must stay Bash3.2/PowerShell5.1+7 compatible; tests may not call live daemon or modify shared config. No source implementation edits by this architect. The two pending tasks that overlap joinTeam/wrappers are structurally ordered after this one (0b40957c and 6aa460bb).
